verdict.rationale: Lorikeet advertises seamless ingestion of ticketing systems, knowledge bases, and internal tools without migration ("Connect Lorikeet in seconds to your ticketing system, knowledge base, and internal tools to seamlessly ingest data", "No migration required: Lorikeet works alongside your existing tools"), and its Coach/Audit features operate directly on the existing knowledge base to find gaps rather than requiring re-authoring. Missing for 10: explicit mention of internal wikis as a supported source, detail on ingesting historical ticket transcripts as training/knowledge data, and independent verification of ingestion breadth beyond vendor docs.
